sprint: BACKLOG.md -- Shapes: 'Solid Fill' vs. 'Paint Inside' Toggle (root Studio only)
task: Closes BACKLOG.md's feature-request line, verbatim: 'For all shapes user should be allowed to choose either solid colors or be allowed to manually color using brush strokes (similar to like doodle functionality).' User's binding answer: 'Toggle: Solid Fill vs. Paint Inside (Recommended)' -- Solid stays today's flat Fill Colour; Paint Inside turns the shape's own silhouette into a clipped canvas reusing Doodle's exact multi-stroke/multi-colour/medium mechanics (Crayon/Pastel/Brush/Spray), with Outline staying separate and always-available in both modes. Root-Studio-only (renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/cardDesigner.js, css/style.css); World Builder v2 untouched. New data model fields on a Shape sticker instance: fillMode ('solid'|'paint', absent means 'solid', zero migration) and paintStrokes (identical shape to Doodle's own st.strokes). Render layer: the 15 preset geometric kinds + 'custom' use a Path2D-based clip (avoiding Canvas 2D's clobbered-current-path hazard when a shape's own outline path and Doodle's per-stroke beginPath() calls would otherwise collide) via a new shared _paintShapePathTail tail helper; the 36 letter/number kinds (fillText/strokeText, no plottable path) use a new _drawLetterShapePaint alpha-mask composite (destination-in), mirroring the existing 'Colour This' Auto Duotone technique. Outline stays unconditional in both modes. _drawSceneShape/_shapeBbox/drawObjectThumbnail all carry the two new fields through, so Object Strip thumbnails show real painted content automatically, letters included. UI (js/cardDesigner.js Shape group): a new 2-button Fill Mode toggle (reusing the existing Line/Circle Tool icon-row pattern); paintStrokes is preserved, never cleared, when toggling back to Solid. A new Paint group mirrors the existing Doodle group's hint/pad/medium-switcher/pen-tools/Undo-Clear structure, reusing DOODLE_MEDIA/palettes verbatim; a new _buildShapeSilhouettePath2D hand-mirrors the renderer's 15 geometry branches for the pad's own clip boundary, and a new _drawShapePaintPad renders the live pad preview using the identical two-technique split (Path2D clip / letter alpha-mask) as the real renderer. A disclosed, narrowly-scoped incidental fix: _drawDoodlePad's pad-preview stroke-width scaling (a fixed constant, ignoring the sticker's actual size) is corrected via a new shared _padStrokeWidth(rawWidth,padSize,objectSize) helper, used by both _drawDoodlePad (gains a 4th objectSize param) and the new Paint-Inside pad -- fixes only the live-editing pad's own internal self-consistency, does NOT touch the real renderer's absolute-width behaviour and is NOT the same root cause as the separate, still-open 'leakage from doodle sketch area to outside area' BACKLOG bug, left untouched this pass. Verified via a new 30-assertion Playwright suite (shapes_paint_inside_verify.js) covering Fill Mode toggle persistence across mode switches, real pointer-drawn strokes clipped to a shape's silhouette (pixel-sampled for zero bleed), Outline controls working identically in both modes, a letter shape's glyph-clipped paint, a custom shape's Paint-Inside pad clipping to its own customStrokes silhouette, real Object Strip thumbnail content, and rotation composing correctly with a Paint-Inside letter shape. Full regression across the existing Creator/Card-Platform Playwright suite (verify_letter_number_shapes.js, verify_font_shapefill.js, verify_image_rotation.js, verify_text_rotation.js, verify_text_rotation_pivot.js, verify_rotation_publish_honored.js, verify_stretch_fit.js, verify_text_align_fidelity_fix.js, verify_text_newline_fix.js, sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js, manageframes_inline_rotation_verify2.js, place_resize_shape_verify.js) all passing unchanged; museum_realfile_pixelhash.js produces the exact same SHA-256 hash (e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390) this project's history has recorded repeatedly, confirming byte-identical rendering for a theme with no Paint-Inside shape authored. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged, confirming zero World Builder impact. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to renderer/slideRenderer.js, js/cardDesigner.js, and css/style.css.
